reason: I paid an agency for a strategy once and got a nice deck and zero customers, so I won't pay 3,500 up front for six weeks of profiles and positioning on a promise. The new country next year is a real need, but 'no number of meetings is guaranteed' tells me the risk is all on my side again.
objection: Most of this sprint sounds like the slides I already paid for once. The 45 meetings came from a logistics company, not a distributor like me, and I can't call anyone to check it.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to a past wholesale or distribution client I can phone myself, plus a small paid pilot in my target country where part of the fee depends on qualified meetings actually being booked.
